chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated from Safwan ibn Yahya from Ishaq ibn 'Ammar who said:

I asked Abu Ibrahim (peace be upon him) about the visitation of the House (Kaaba) when it is delayed until the third day. He said: 'Hastening it is more beloved to me, and there is no harm in it if you delay it.'

key_terms.وَلَيْسَ بِهِ بَأْسٌ: And there is no harm in it

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to delay the visitation of the Kaaba until the third day of Hajj?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifies the legal status of delaying the Tawaf al-Ifadah until the third day of Tashriq, distinguishing between the preferred practice (istihbab) and the permissible ruling (ibahah). This establishes a nuanced jurisprudential principle where flexibility is granted to pilgrims without invalidating the ritual, reflecting the Shia emphasis on ease within worship. The hadith underscores the balance between ritual precision and practical accommodation in the performance of Hajj.
